title: Rocketman
tagline: Feathers on, platforms laced, prawns in the glass.
about: A shy piano prodigy from Pinner becomes a glam rock superstar, with his songwriting partner beside him and a lot to work through.
cue: Serve the prawn cocktail when Elton walks out at the Los Angeles club for his first American show.
faces: West Hollywood, August 1970. Feet off the floor.
Piano's tuned and the boots are polished. Feed the kid from Pinner before doors, he gets too nervous to eat after.
Feathers on, platforms laced, prawns in the glass.
King prawns on iceberg, cucumber and avocado with pink Marie Rose sauce, paprika.
Nan's Pinner cheese and pineapple hedgehog
Cocktail sticks of sharp cheddar, pineapple, pickled onions.
Seared beef rump strips with mushrooms, onion, paprika, mustard and sour cream.
Bernie, the farm boy from Lincolnshire, writing the words to Your Song.
Layers of vanilla and strawberry ice cream, mixed berries, raspberry sauce and whipped cream.
Tequila and fresh orange juice over ice, grenadine sunk to the bottom in a sunrise.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing a flamboyant devil's outfit at the tables. Card No. 1970. Showtime: Serve the prawn cocktail when Elton walks out at the Los Angeles club for his first American show.
